name: support_queue
description: Dynamic SLA-aware priority queue for a small IT helpdesk

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
